# OpenProgram 0.5.0 Release Notes

Code completion date: June 7, 2026. GitHub Release date: July 4, 2026. This version expanded collaboration, permissions, project configuration, conversation DAGs, installation, and multi-account management. It did not include the complete product assets required by the current distribution standard.

## ✨ New features

- Added agent collaboration through `message_branch` for creating, forking, and contacting conversation branches and returning replies to the caller.
- Added cross-session discovery, multi-branch synthesis, depth/self-call limits, and isolated worktrees for branches that modify files.
- Added five Claude Code-style permission modes, deny-first rules, path safety checks, and three approval outcomes.
- Added a Projects page, project-level defaults and permission rules, and session organization by project.
- Added automatic branch naming, branch markers, rewind, and a React detail panel for the Conversation DAG.
- Added unified Provider account/profile management, active accounts, API-key rotation, and cooldowns.
- Added a cross-platform one-command source installer with GPU/CUDA, Browser, Channel, and first-party Program options.

## 🐞 Bug fixes

- Fixed missing predecessors on user messages that created incorrect DAG branches on every turn.
- Fixed the head continuing to reference a reverted node after rewind.
- Fixed compatibility between OpenAI strict tool schemas and the Codex Provider.
- Fixed several first-run, Provider configuration, and multi-account state inconsistencies.

## 🚀 Improvements

- Consolidated the Web UI around one chat layout, one service port, and PWA startup.
- Added updated project branding, sidebar wordmark, favicon, and status-indicator styles.
- Made the complete project installer the primary installation path and stopped presenting `pip install` as a complete product installation.

## 📦 Availability

This historical version did not provide complete product assets under the current standard. Its old source installer is retained for historical reproduction and is not the current ordinary-user installation path. Install the [latest stable Release](https://github.com/Fzkuji/OpenProgram/releases/latest).
